environment.description: Kubernetes pod on EKS 1.28 in namespace 'prod-fileservice'. A namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy named 'restrict-link-local' is applied with spec.podSelector matching all pods (matchLabels: app=export-service), spec.policyTypes=['Egress'], and a single egress rule allowing traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT with an explicit ipBlock.cidr 169.254.0.0/16 in the 'except' field of an otherwise permissive egress CIDR block. The CNI plugin is AWS VPC CNI v1.14 with network policy enforcement enabled via ENABLE_NETWORK_POLICY=true in the aws-node DaemonSet environment. Pod runs as UID 1000 with readOnlyRootFilesystem=false but the exports volume is mounted with type emptyDir. Note: the NetworkPolicy only restricts egress to the link-local range; all other egress including DNS (port 53) and internal services remains permitted.
